info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Replace Webhook Statu-spec
info.description: The Webhook Status Update API allows users to modify the status of existing webhooks in the notification subscription system. This operation is essential for managing webhook delivery settings effectively, ensuring that the correct notifications are sent based on the desired status. Typical consumers include developers and system administrators who require the ability to enable or disable webhooks seamlessly as business needs evolve. Use cases involve updating webhook statuses to reflect operational changes or to pause notifications during maintenance periods.

put.summary: Update the status of a specific webhook.
put.description: This operation allows you to update the status of the webhook identified by RES-100045. Ensure you provide the necessary data to reflect the new status effectively.

requestBody.description: Update the status of the webhook with the given identifier. This request requires a JSON payload containing the new status information.
